title: Integral quotient completion inverts its unit
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and any scheme X, with unrelated scheme and coefficient universes. In the ambient derived category D of completed integral coefficient sheaves on X_proet, let F be IntegralOnSlice.completion and eta its prescribed quotient/Roos completion unit [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. For every M in D the morphism F(eta_M):F(M) -> F(F(M)) is an isomorphism. There is no boundedness, constructibility or completeness condition on M.

proof.text: Use a small model of the essentially small pro-etale site in coefficient universe max(u,t+1). The principal uniformizer datum is Noetherian and its powers have the specified two-term free resolutions. These resolve the actual quotient maps, with their quotient augmentations and compatible successor maps.

source.place: Tag 099M (lemma-naive-completion); returned detailed step 2, completion-unit mapping property; algebraization.tex Tags 099B and 0A0E

proof.text: Apply the completed-coefficient quotient/Koszul comparison on the small site. The free-resolution augmentations identify the two strict quotient towers. Exact countable products identify their total right limits with the Roos cone defining IntegralOnSlice.completion. The degree-zero components are the actual quotient units x to 1 tensor x and the zero cone component, so the comparison identifies the specified natural units, not only the completion objects.

source.place: Tag 099M (lemma-naive-completion); returned detailed step 2, completion-unit mapping property; algebraization.tex Tags 099B and 0A0E

proof.text: Koszul completion is a reflector onto locally derived complete objects. A reflector sends its own unit to an isomorphism: its adjunction triangular identities and invertible counit supply the inverse. Conjugate this isomorphism by the unit-preserving comparison from the preceding step, and transport along the small-site equivalence. The resulting morphism is exactly F(eta_M).

theorem integralCompletion_unit_inverted
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
